# MotionCorr #265 native round-trip oracle: constructed serializer probes.
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-or-later
#
# FROZEN before the first harness run (see FROZEN_BEFORE_RUN.txt for the hash).
# These are constructed coefficient vectors, not fits to any movie. They make
# no accuracy claim about any real movie; they probe the STAR serializer only.
#
# Coefficient layout (ThirdOrderPolynomialModel::getShiftAt), per dimension:
#   idx 0,1,2   z, z^2, z^3        (x^0 y^0 term)
#   idx 3,4,5   z, z^2, z^3  * x
#   idx 6,7,8   z, z^2, z^3  * x^2
#   idx 9,10,11 z, z^2, z^3  * y
#   idx 12,13,14 z, z^2, z^3 * y^2
#   idx 15,16,17 z, z^2, z^3 * x*y
# z = 0-indexed frame, x = pixel_x/width - 0.5, y = pixel_y/height - 0.5.
# Shifts are in unbinned absolute pixels.
#
# Sampling: every fixture is evaluated on every GEOMETRY, at every position
# (fractions of (size-1), per axis) plus the explicit extra pixels, and at
# every integer frame 0..FRAMES-1.
GEOMETRY G1 3838 3710
GEOMETRY G2 5760 4092
FRACTIONS 0 0.25 0.5 0.75 1
EXTRA_PIXEL 1000.5 2500.25
FRAMES 50
# Reporting ranges (inclusive, 0-indexed frames).
RANGE early 0 5
RANGE mid 6 17
RANGE late24 18 23
RANGE gap 24 33
RANGE late40 34 39
RANGE gap2 40 43
RANGE late50 44 49
RANGE all 0 49
